summary: Official DRC cadastral ministry pages and formal land-record procedure were inspected. Haut-Lomami’s directory lists Kamina and Kanyama jurisdictions, but no anonymous Mulongo parcel ID plus full geometry response was verified. No GeoJSON sample is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and French discovery queries, exact text, outcomes, and actual first-party URLs are recorded in city-6465-mulongo.json.
requestOutcomes: Official pages were readable. Current site configuration exposed a Supabase host, but TLS-verified REST requests returned HTTP 401 requiring a key. No credentials, private token, login, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe fields were used; an initial exploratory host curl used -k but returned no data and was not relied upon.
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [-7.83385955265596, 26.9965375561645] and population fields were preserved; no exact-point test was performed.
National ministry directory/procedure evidence does not establish a local Mulongo registry custodian or open parcel coverage.
The Kamina/Kanyama jurisdiction listing is not parcel geometry and does not prove Mulongo coverage or absence.
A 401/key wall, inaccessible endpoint, unavailable UI, or missing anonymous response is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
Only stable native parcel ID, geometry, CRS, and public service metadata were in scope; no unsafe attributes were requested or retained.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not performed; no usable public parcel geometry response.
